```sql
SELECT
  SUM(oi.product_price) - SUM(o.order_cost) AS gross_profit_2025,
  (SUM(oi.product_price) - SUM(o.order_cost)) / SUM(oi.product_price) AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND oi.ordered_at < '2026-01-01';
```
